items.subject: Warp-local register/shuffle transpose
items.objective: Own only src/candidate.cu. Independently explore a warp-register transpose using warp lane permutations/shuffles to turn coalesced input loads into coalesced output stores, aiming to avoid CTA shared-memory staging and its block-wide synchronization. Design and describe element ownership so each shuffle exchange uses data held by participating lanes in the same warp; do not assume a warp shuffle exchanges data across warps. Tune the warp's element ownership and tile mapping, and report register/spill evidence if present in the ordinary build output. Preserve exact bitwise copies and the run entry point, produce all output for every positive n multiple of 32, pass the required correctness sizes, allocate no new storage, and report repeated full-run n=1024 timing evidence.
